title: Pack manifest
description: Root file of a pack (manifest.yaml or manifest.json at the pack root). Declares identity, required domain adapters (ADR-0009), registry selections with every parameter (ADR-0002, ADR-0004, ADR-0013), the generation defaults (ADR-0014) and the index of every other file in the pack. The harness has no defaults: anything the pack needs is declared here.

pack_format.description: Version of the pack schema set in contracts/schemas/pack/. A breaking change introduces a new value and new schema files.

pack_version.description: Human-facing label; the pack content hash is the identity (ADR-0010).

domain_adapters.description: Domain adapter id -> accepted version range. Every adapter item (fixture, check, tool) the pack references must be registered by one of these adapters, or the Importer refuses the pack (ADR-0009). The version actually used is recorded on session.started.

registry.description: Registry role -> selected implementation and all its parameters (ADR-0004). v0.1 requires 'learner_model'; policy and assessment are v0.2+. Every v0.1 implementation is an LLM implementation (ADR-0013), so every role uses the LLM selection shape. 'memo_summarizer' is optional: when present, the harness writes a learning memo for every highlight thread (memo.recorded); when absent, no memos are recorded.

content_generation.description: Pack-level generation parameters (ADR-0014). Required when the pack has any activity_template.

max_regenerations.description: Regeneration attempts after a failed validation before falling back to an authored Definition.

files.description: Index of every file in the pack except the manifest: pack-relative path -> kind. The kind selects the schema the Importer validates the file against. A file present in the pack but absent here, or indexed but missing, makes the Importer refuse the pack.

kind.description: Schema per kind: skill -> skill.json, activity -> activity-definition.json, reference_solution -> reference-solution.json, environment -> environment.json, activity_template -> activity-template.json, generation_record -> generation-record.json, evaluator -> evaluator.json, visualization -> visualization.json, reference -> reference.json, layout -> layout.json, prompt -> plain text (not schema-validated; identified by prompt_id + prompt_version here).

llm_selection.title: LLM implementation selection
llm_selection.description: An LLM-backed registry implementation and all its parameters. 'llm' has exactly the shape of LLM provenance, so events copy it verbatim (ADR-0010, ADR-0016). The prompt is a pack file indexed with kind 'prompt'.

output_schema.description: $id of the structured-output schema under contracts/schemas/llm/.

options.description: Implementation-specific parameters (e.g. a cap on how far one update may move mastery, ADR-0013). Validated by the registered implementation at import; the harness supplies no defaults.

judgment_selection.title: LLM selection whose output affects learner state or presented content
judgment_selection.description: Output must be schema-validated (ADR-0013, ADR-0014), so output_schema is required.
